claim: Let \(A=(\mathbb R^2,\|\cdot\|_A)\) be the real regular-octagonal plane with \(\|(u,v)\|_A=\max\{|u|+(\sqrt2-1)|v|,\ |v|+(\sqrt2-1)|u|\}\). For the Baronti--Franchetti minimax parameter \(\Lambda(A)=\inf_{x,y\in S_A}\sup_{f\in S_{A^*}}\min\{|f(x)|,|f(y)|\}\), the exact value is \(\sqrt2/(1+\sqrt{4-2\sqrt2})\). Equality is achieved by the interior isosceles-orthogonal pair \(x=(1/s,r_0/s),\ y=(-r_0/s,1/s)\) where \(a=\sqrt2-1,\ s=\sqrt{1+a^2},\ r_0=a/(1+s)\).
integrity: Exact facet/dual computations give both isosceles branches; four signed cones extend their common sharp lower bound to all pairs of unit vectors.
scientific_limitations: The exact value is specific to the regular octagonal plane. It does not classify general regular polygons or all symmetric normed planes; historical priority outside inspected sources is not guaranteed.
title: Exact Baronti--Franchetti parameter of the regular octagonal plane
